title: Topotactic Synthesis of Mesoporous 12CaO·7Al2O3 (C12A7) Mesocrystalline Microcubes towards Catalytic Ammonia Synthesis
extraction_notes: No catalyst-performance entries (NH3 synthesis rate, outlet NH3 concentration, or TOF) are reported in the Supporting Information. The SI catalytic activity measurement section (SI pages 5–6) reports general reaction conditions for Ru-loaded 5 wt% C12A7 catalysts (H2/N2 = 3, 60 mL min–1, 0.1 g catalyst, ambient/atmospheric-pressure recalculation; actual tube pressures 0.15 MPa for Ru@C12A7 and 0.22 MPa for Ru@re-C12A7), but it does not print any ammonia synthesis rate, outlet NH3, or TOF values. Tables S1–S3 and Figures S1–S16 are characterization data and are out of scope.
